script_text: The stars are aligning to fundamentally reshape your relationships this week, Aquarius. The Sun enters Libra Monday, landing in your 8th House of Transformation, stirring deep emotional currents. Your ruling planet Uranus — the force behind your air sign intuition — forms a tense square to Saturn, igniting power struggles in partnerships that demand honest confrontation. Wednesday is your worst day; avoid major decisions as this aspect peaks. Mid-week, Mercury enters Libra in a trine to your natal Uranus in your 7th House, unlocking breakthrough communication with a romantic partner. This shift changes everything. By Friday, Venus enters your 8th House, sparking a passionate love connection that feels fated. Career-wise, Mars in your 11th House energizes collaborations — a financial opportunity surfaces through your network. Thursday is your power day because Venus trine Jupiter expands joy into your 5th House of creativity. Trust the silence before the breakthrough. Follow for daily updates.
